description: This Java class defines a log filter used in an Android logging framework. Its purpose is to pass only the message part of log entries downstream, filtering out metadata such as priority, tag, and throwable. It supports chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter that forwards only the message part of log entries to the next LogNode, omitting metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode for chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Handles a log entry by passing only the message to the next LogNode, if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode for chaining.
